newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yield rises on Bulgaria 4-week discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yield rises on Bulgaria 4-week discount T-bills.

text.p: Yield rose on Bulgaria's Finance Ministry four-week discount T-bills at the daily auction on Tuesday as the issue was undersubscribed, central bank figures show.
The average yield to maturity on the issue was 3.78 percent, up from 3.76 percent at Monday's auction and 3.77 percent on Friday.
Bids were received for a total of 23.236 billion levs worth of paper at an average price of 96.36 percent of par and the ministry accepted all bids at that price.
The issue was offered with a par value of 26 billion levs and no minimum acceptable price set in advance.

This week the Finance ministry has not offered one-week discount T-bills after the central bank said on Thursday that it will adjust its main interest rate only to the weighted average effective annual yield of four-week discount paper.

Until last week the central bank has been adjusting its main interest rate, now 43.08 percent annually, to the weighted average effective annual yield of one-week and four-week discount T-bills sold daily by the Finance ministry.
